batting.name: JEC Franklin
batting.dismissal: c M Manhas b B Kumar

batting.name: SR Tendulkar
batting.dismissal: c RV Uthappa b A Nehra

batting.name: RJ Peterson
batting.dismissal: c SC Ganguly b A Nehra

batting.name: Harbhajan Singh
batting.dismissal: c WD Parnell b AB Dinda

batting.name: JD Ryder
batting.dismissal: c NLTC Perera b Harbhajan Singh

batting.name: WD Parnell
batting.dismissal: c RJ Peterson b SL Malinga

balls.text: out, run-out! Outside the off stump, wanted to drive, missed, they went for the bye and Uthappa has thrown the stumps down direct. Mumbai have ended on 120/9
pitched up, gets an inside edge, goes to fine-leg for a single. Karthik will play the last ball of what has been one of the better T20 spells.

pitched up to the bat and driven to the long-off, they took a single and Malinga wanted to go for the second, Karthik did not. It was a casual, but powerful throw to the striker's end from Smith in the deep and the bails are dislodged with the batsman well out!
pitched right up yet again and it is drilled through the covers for a single
pitched right up and Malinga gets some bat on it, can only get it back to the bowler
tries to paddle sweep it away, gets one that is outside the off stump, gets an outside edge to third-man for a single.
slower ball and that is a SIX! Finally a shade of that thing they usually call momentum! Slower ball and Malinga came down and smacked it over long-on for a biggie...
and now Malinga gets a four, would you believe it! He wanted to slog it over the mid-wicket and it gets an inside-edge, through the gap between short fine-leg and square-leg, no fine-leg in place
full-toss, wanted to swing it away and hits the inside edge of the bat, gets only a single to deep mid-wicket
slower one, tries to sweep it and hits only the pads, but it is a no-ball, free-hit!
shot, four, what is a four? It is a first boundary after the 10th over I think! Full-toss carted over mid-wicket for a four.
slower one, pitched up and Malinga has scooped it over the bowler, finally a single for Malinga early in the over
pitched up, goes for a swing, misses again and goes through to the keeper.
on the pads, tries to play it away to the leg-side, misses the bat, hits the pads, goes to the off side and they are able to get away for a single
outside the off stump, tries to drive without moving his feet anywhere and misses again.
bouncer and Malinga takes evasive action, well bowled and well left.
outside the off-stump, slower one, tries to cut it away but the bounce is rather low and he misses.
short of length, Malinga stands up tall, defends to the off side.
slower , tried to cut, before open the face of the bat and dabbing it to third-man for a single
full-toss, outside the off-stump, Karthik tries to drive but gets no timing behind it, flicked away for a single
pitched up, on the leg stump, driven to deep square-leg for a single
pitched right up, driven to mid-off and Karthik gets a single. He did not bat at four today and seems to be running out of partners.
backs away, gives himself room, driven through the covers for a single
yorker attempted first up against Malinga, turns into a full-toss, back to the bowler
gone, caught! Mumbai Indians are imploding here, Dinda comes back on, Harbhajan tries to punch it through the covers, goes to the left of short cover, where Parnell dives and plucks out a good catch!

run-out appeal, third umpire called! They went for a single, after there was an appeal for an lbw, the umpire ruled him not-out for the lbw but Perera was slow to get to the other end and Smith, from point, hits the stump direct, end of the Sri Lankan all-rounder!
a good length ball, tries to hit on the up, misses through to the wicket-keeper yet again
tries to cut a ball that was too close to, keeps a tad low as well and beats the batsman.
well bowled, on the middle, quicker from Nehra, dabs it to the off side for a single
pitched up, outside the off stump and missed again! Went for a drive and he did not get any bat on it.
tries to drive it on the up, missed and straight to the keeper
flicked away to the square-leg and that ends an excellent over from Kumar. Three runs and a wicket in the 15th.
out, bowled! A slower one, fingers rolled over the ball and Rayadu tries to cut it away and he missed reading the pace of the ball, sneaks through and he is bowled.
pushed away for a single, they need to get a bit of an upping of ante here
slower, pushed to the leg side, fielded by the bowler
on the middle stump, opens the bat, pushed to the off side for a single
short and pulled but straight to the deep square-leg for a single
on the middle stump, Rayadu goes on to the back foot and defends. The run-rate's almost six and we have a Time-Out.
opens the face of the bat this time and they get a single to third-man, 137.5km/hr
outside the off stump, driven to backward point and fielded by Smith.
top-edge and this is caught! Short ball yet again and Peterson tries to go for a pull, comes on faster to the batsman, gets a top-edge and Ganguly runs in from long-off to take the catch.
going down the pitch and he tries to pull it away, to the fine-leg fielder
outside the off stump, moving further away, Karthik tries to play it through third-man, misses and it goes to the wicket-keeper
driven to long-off and that is a single for Karthik

lbw appeal, given not-out, run-out chance, missed! It was pitched up, and it hit the pads as he tried to flick it away, probably going down the leg side, Smith's direct hit at the non-striker's end would have seen him walk back
angling away and opens the bat through to third-man for a single
quicker this time and pushed down the ground for a single
pitched up but did not seem to have come on to the bat, goes in the air and to the right of short cover. Slower ball too.
good length, outside the off stump, dabbed away to third-man for a single

nicked and gone! Tendulkar is out! Nehra might have dropped Peterson but he has got the important wicket of Sachin Tendulkar, tried to late-cut it through third-man but gets an edge through to the wicket-keeper
punched to the off side, but straight to the fielder.
dropped is it? And I was just speaking of they not having dropped any so far! Shortish, wanted to pull, went back to the bowler over his head and he fails to hold on!
on the middle stump, punched through the covers for a single, he had opened the bat there.
goes down the pitch, tries to pull it away, misses and so does the wicket-keeper, they are off for a bye. The fielding has been scratchy from Pune so far, but no drops. Yet anyway.
outside the off stump, pushed to the point region and it goes quickly to the fielder, nothing for Peterson.
cut it away to the point region where Ganguly isn't able to stop it, but the single was always on and that is all that they get.
slows it down a little, tries to paddle sweep it, but does not get it to the middle of the bat, goes to Nehra.
down the pitch, pushed to the off side and they are off for a quick single. A direct hit would have been interesting.
another one of those dabs, to Nehra and a poor throw misses the wicket-keeper, to go for an overthrow.
outside the off stump, quicker one, tries to cut it but it goes to the fielder at short third-man. Nehra fields.
on his pads, middle-stump and driven to the leg side for a single
on the middle, pitched right up to the bat and pushed to the leg side for a single
on the leg side, pushed to the leg side for a single to deep square-leg
pitched right up and he tries to dab it down through short third-man, probably bit of an edge and it goes for a four.
pushed to the leg side and goes to square-leg for nothing.
on the middle, pushed to the leg side for a single
this time it will be four off the bat for Tendulkar! He tried to adjust the line by bowling on the middle stump, paddle sweeps it through the fine-leg region for four
that is down the leg side, it did not spin and it has gone for four wides

run-out! There was a huge appeal for an lbw, Sharma wanted to go for a run in the mean time, Tendulkar was having none of it and the fielder at short third-man throws it to the wicket-keeper, Uthappa removes the bails and Sharma's rather short stay at the crease has ended.
outside the off stump, good length, almost flicks it back to the bowler
outside the off stump and Tendulkar unleashes a sweep, goes to the deep square-leg fielder for a single
quicker on his pads, dabbed away to the leg side for a single
goes down the track, hits the pad and it pops up to the leg side and they are off for one
pitched right up, driven straight to short cover and Jesse Ryder misfields.
on his pads, the batsman leans into the shot, drives it through the on-side for a single
punched down the ground to long-on for a single
top-edge and caught! Franklin tried to pull it away, it was not too short and it goes up, behind the bowler and the fielder at long-on comes in to take that easily.
outside the off-stump, the ball keeps low and Franklin pushes it to the short cover
dabbed on the off stump, they are off for a quick single, the bowler ran, picked it up well and threw the stumps down at the striker's end, but the batsman was in.
on the middle stump, played it away, straight to short mid-wicket
catch it was the call from everyone around but did Nehra not go for it? He was paddle sweeping, got an edge and it went to the left of Nehra, was in the air for a long time!
drives it inside-out to wide long-off, bit of misfield, a couple of runs
change in action, almost Shane Warnesque from Kartik, no turn though, driven to long-off for a run
on his pads, works it away to short fine-leg for a single
outside the off stump, tries to cut it away but gets no timing on this one and it drops very close on the off side, they are able to rush off for one.
on his pads, Tendulkar works it away to the deep square-leg region for a single
a dot ball to end, outside the off stump, punched to the covers and that is the end of Powerplay overs too.
smashed it away for four! The delivery was shorter this time and much like how he lofted the six, he pulls it over the mid-wicket for a four this time
cute, cheeky or clever, you decide, but this gets him four! Pitched a tad short, Franklin sees the ball on to his bat, opens its face and it goes through the region where slips would have been.
outside the off stump, on a length, punched to the off side and it goes to the fielder in the covers
launched, that cannot be anything but a launch! It was pitched right up to the bat and he has smacked it with the angle over mid-wicket for the first six of the innings
pitched short of length, on the middle stump, he tries to play it through the leg side but it does not go too far.
bowling within the stumps, Franklin on-drives and is off for a single
punched to the off side to the fielder
goes down the pitch to nudge it away to the off side and they are off for a single
well bowled, slowed it down a tad, almost a quickish leggie, squares the batsman a little
outside the leg-stump, Franklin wanted to punch it away to the deep square-leg,misses, hits the pads and they are off fora leg-bye. They were appealing for an lbw.
goes down the pitch, wanted to lift it over mid-off, mistimes it as well, goes to the fielder and they have time to take the single
flicked away this time, the fine-leg is up in the circle so that the deep square-leg can be in place and it goes straight to that fielder for a single
outside the off stump, pitched up yet again and he tries to play it through the covers, goes to the fielder
three in three, Tendulkar has gone down the track and taken it on the full, turns his bat to create a gap through the left of point and Smith had no chance
punched back again, this time to the left of the bowler, but far, far away right of the mid-off fielder and suddenly they have their third boundary in four balls.
finally a shot, and finally a four! That was pitched up to the bat, fullish, on the middle stump and Tendulkar plays a check drive over mid-on for a one-bounce four.
on his pads and Tendulkar tries to flick it away to square-leg, misses yet again, seven dots for Dinda
pitched up to the bat and Franklin goes over mid-on to bring up the first boundary of the innings! A bit of a sedate start but the boundary will help
outside the off stump and on the length, punched to the off-side but it is a no-ball, a big one too. Free-Hit time
outside the off stump, and pushed to the covers.
short of good length, probably in the slot to smash it away, pull it away, tries it but misses.
outside the off-stump, good length, punched to the left of mid-off and Tendulkar is away for a quick one.
pitched up this time and driven to the mid-on, where Sourav Ganguly misfields. It was a single anyway, so no harm done.
on the off stump, short of good length, punches it back to the bowler
maiden over from Dinda, pitched on middle, up to the bat, Tendulkar tries to flick it, gets an inside edge on to his pads.
drifts down Tendulkar's pads, who flicks it away and that should have been put away to the fence, but it goes straight to the short fine-leg fielder
on the middle, Tendulkar wanted to punch it down the ground, flicks it a little at the last moment and it goes to mid-on
similar delivery, outside the off stump, driven, to the right of the fielder, Michael Clarke and again fielded well
outside the off stump,moving slightly away, Tendulkar drives to the covers and the fielder does not have to move much to field that
driven to the off side, straight to the fielder
pitched right up to the bat, driven back to the bowler
the ball keeps a tad low, on the back foot, played away to the leg side for a single
takes the foot out, tries to flick it away to the leg side, loud appeal for reasons unknown because his pads were way outside the off stump
on the middle stump, no turn so far, flicked away through mid-wicket for a single
this time it is down the leg-side, the batsman flicks it away through square-leg and a bit of a clumsy effort from Bhuvneshwar Kumar saves two.
pitched up, front foot's out and defended back to the bowler
full-toss, flicked away and it goes straight to deep mid-wicket and they get only a couple of runs, Mumbai Indians have won by a solitary run.
shot, shot, shot, four, inside out, through wide long-off and that brings the equation down to four from one. Slower one too and played really well.
cut away, slower one outside the off stump, and it goes on the bounce to deep point. Only a single. Two boundaries needed here.
pitched up yet again from Munaf and BK drives it through the covers for a single
pitched up and drilled to long-off, but only for a single
slow as slow can get from a pace bowler, and that was wide outside the off-stump, Manhas however had gone too close to it and still called a wide.
goes down the pitch, wanted to cut it away, misses and that makes the equation tougher.
yorker, as a typical yorker should be, and that is dug out well by Manhas, single to point. 12 needed off six.
down the leg side, slower, flicked away and it spoons up, but well short of the short fine-leg, a single for Kumar.
well bowled, surprised the batsman with the lack of pace and shortening of length, it kept low too, to be fair to the batsman, missed by him
yorker length, into the block-hole and Kumar is able to get some bat on it, whipped away to the leg side and they are off for a couple of runs. Crucial.
gone, out, caught! Outside the off-stump, tries to cut it away, hits the bottom of the bat and it loops it up for the point fielder to take a simple catch. Two dots here.
pitched full, outside the off-stump and he tries to go for the cut, fails to get any bat on it, and not called a wide.
down the track and smashed back, the bowler does not get a hand to it and for at least the second time this tournament, Asad Rauf is on the ground!
pitched up, reverse sweep attempted, but goes to the fielder at short fine-leg
down the leg side and he attempts a sweep, misses and its a wide
cut away, from outside the leg-stump, this man loves to play this stroke and I am speaking of the biggest understatement of the evening.
on his pads, down the leg side, pitched right up to the bat, and tapped it away to the leg side for a single
down the leg-side, shorter, tries to paddle it and goes straight to the fielder at short fine-leg, Tendulkar fields there.
edged and four! Manhas is playing those cuts rather well, and although this one was an outside edge, it goes in the gap, slips and four!
out, bowled! Just when he seemed like he was getting some of the timing back, Malinga has gone through his defences, Ganguly went for a slog, missed and is bowled!
wide, again, outside the off stump! Yep, the pressure is definitely on, Ganguly was moving around the crease and he pushes it away
wide this time, outside the off-stump and Ganguly went for his cut, missed it and it is easily a wide. Pressure on the bowler for the first time?
shot, second one off the midlde of the bat and it has been smacked over the bowler's head for a four between long-on and long-off. The crowds are ecstatic, although the run-rate needed is nine...
yorker attempted, instead it is a full-toss and Manhas is able to play it through mid-wicket for a single. Ganguly is back on.
slower one from Malinga, short of length, tries to tap it through third-man but he misses.
finally off the middle of the bat, pitched right up, outside the off stump, driven and straight to the left of point, dives and stops and they are off for a single
shorter, tapped away to the third-man for a single
goes on to the off stump, tries to paddle it to the fine-leg, which is in position and they get only a single. Nine from the over and that is exactly what they need every over from here on.
slog shot, over mid-wicket and a four they desperately needed! Manhas is playing a gem here...
slower, outside the off stump, goes for a drive but can get only to the long-off fielder.
driven powerfully through to the long-off for a single
slower, on the middle, Ganguly wanted to go over the long-on, does not get too much of a bat and it trickles to long-on
round the wicket, cut away to the third-man for a single
finally is able to unleash his favourite cut but goes to the sweeper fielder for only a run
driven to the short mid-wicket and there is no run again!
shorter, cut away to the sweeper for a single
pitched right up, outside the off and Ganguly drives it to shot cover. Pressure, a bit of it for sure.
on the middle stump yet again, goes on to the back foot and defended.
on the middle-stump, defended back to the bowler
down the leg side, tries to whip it away, missed, wide called
wanted to go down the pitch, then went on to his back foot and punched it to the covers
shot, four and this is already turning out to be a very useful cameo!
paddle sweep, over the wicket-keeper's head and they are able to take a second run there.
shorter, turning away, tries the cut but the spin defeats his timing
pitched up to the bat, driven to short cover.
on his pads, short of length, nudged away to the leg side for a single
down the leg side, turned away to the fine-leg region where the fielder at the deep square-leg runs to and fields it, not before they have got their second though, does the throw come in.
tries to cut it away yet again, on the bounce to point, Rohit Sharma fields and there is no run.
cut again and that is his second four! This time it went rather fine, beats the fine-leg on his left and another decent over for the Warriors.
outside the off-stump, angles the bat to the off side and taps it away for a single. The third-man is up in the circle but the lack of pace does not allow the batsman to get it through for four
from round the wicket again, outside the off-stump, angling in, cut away to third-man for a single
outside the off stump, taps it to the off side for a single
good shot on a slow track, it was a quicker ball alright, but he brings out a West Indies-like cut through point, once it had beaten the fielder at point, it was going only one way.
inside edge and gets off for a single, good length ball on the off-stump
wristily cuts away to the third-man region for a single
flicked away and falls between three fielders, one running behind and two coming in. The timing went awry there for someone who has only just arrived at the crease.
short of length, quicker, 128.8 km/hr and defended it into the covers
pitched right up, wanted to drive, but gets an outside edge, on the bounce to the keeper
outside the off-stump, opens the face of the bat and taps it to third-man for only the second single of the over, pushing the required-rate to eight an over.
around the wicket, outside the off stump, driven to short cover
shorter this time from Franklin and the batsman cuts it away to the sweeper fielder for a single
similar delivery, same line, length and pace and Ganguly plays the same shot, defended with a straight bat, back to the bowler
on the off-stump, short of length, no pace on it and defended back to the bowler.
on the pads, driven to short mid-wicket and straight to the fielder.
pitched right up to the batsman, defended on the leg side and that is the end of another very good over.
out, bowled! Goes down the pitch, wanted to play it straight back to long-on, misses it and is bowled, this is turning out to be an exciting one.
swept away for a single by Ganguly
big, big appeal this time, wanted to sweep it away and he seemed to have missed it, but the umpire has given it not-out. Probably an inside-edge...
pushed to the leg side for a single
turn away and defended on the front foot
pitched right up to the bat, defended back to the bowler and that is the end of a successful over from Harbhajan Singh.
nudged away to the short fine-leg fielder to get off the mark
driven to the leg-side and fielded by the short mid-wicket fielder
pushes it to the leg side, pitched right up and that is well fielded

out, lbw, but was that out, I don't think so! Clarke tried to sweep it away, missed and from round the stumps, this seemed to be going over the off-stump, or at least away from it. The umpire did not think so!
defended off the back foot, back to the bowler
on the middle-stump and it turned did this one, punched to the leg side, Ganguly wanted a single but Clarke sends him back.
outside the off-stump, shorter this time and Clarke pushes it through the covers
outside the off stump, punched through the covers
on the middle stump, a bit of turn, turns it to the leg-side but to the fielder inside the circle
and on the pads again, this time of Clarke, and he has flicked it away to fine-leg for one
on the leg stump, turning further down, nudged away to fine-leg for a single
outside the off stump, wants to work it away through the mid-wicket region and it goes straight to the fielder at short mid-wicket.
gone, caught! Ryder has holed out to long-on for deep mid-on to come in for a very well-judged catch. Tried to hit it in the gap, but ended up chipping it straight to him.
shimmies down the pitch, drives to long-on for a single.
on the middle stump, plays away to the leg side for a single, wanted a single but Clarke wisely tells him no.
on his pads, nudged away to the leg side for a single
round the wicket, on the front-foot, defended back to the bowler
widish outside the off-stump, driven but straight to the mid-off fielder.
shot, classically driven through the on-side and it is a pity it is only a single. Superb timing
another pull attempted and it hits a bit high on the bat, did not go where Ryder wanted, falls short of Rayadu at deep square-leg
pitched up on his pads this time and that is easy hitting for the batsman, he needed to flick it away and that's run away for a four!
quicker, went for the pull, 133.5 km/hr, misses the pull and goes to the keeper who is up to the stumps
outside the off stump, wanted to heave it away, but can get it away only to mid-on
on the middle, hint of a turn, played away to the leg side for a single. Harbhajan has conceded 11 from it.
down the pitch yet again and this time he seems to be early in his stroke, manages a dab to mid-on for a single
down the pitch and he has been smacked for four over mid-off!
swept away for four! There wasn't anyone at backward square-leg and Clarke splits the gap between short fine-leg and square-leg
short from Harbhajan, flicks it away to the leg side for a single
outside the off stump, pitched up, pushed on the front foot to the fielder
steps out of the pitch, but defended back to the bowler. Good over from Patel
outside the off stump, tries to cut it, but the ball refuses to come on to the bat well enough for him to time the shot too well and it goes to the point fielder
on his pads,pitched up, driven to short mid-wicket

given out, lbw! Was that high? Uthappa moved around in the crease, the pads were in front of the stumps and he missed, hits the pads and the appeal was upheld. Height could have been an issue there, but the umpire certainly did not think so.
slowish, on the pads, flicked away to the deep square-leg fielder for a single. Ryder's scored his first this evening.
on the middle, short of good length, defended back to the bowler
driven and for a four! It was outside the off stump, length ball and driven on the up and another over where they manage six.
outside the off-stump, kept rather low, went for a slash, misses because it was widish and did not bounce too much
that is a classic flick shot, up and over the square-leg fielder and they come back for the second. Was a slower one from Malinga
edged, this time for sure, but does not carry through to Dinesh Karthik behind! Things happening for the first time for Mumbai Indians...
on the middle, played to the leg side, to short mid-wicket where Harbhajan has positioned himself
edged, is it? It looked like there was some edge, or at least some noise, and through to the wicket-keeper, there was a loud appeal from everyone around, but the umpire gives it not-out.
outside the off stump, defended on the front foot to the short cover fielder. That was the first ball he faced did Ryder
played away to the leg side for a single, they do not need too many more than six an over
tries to run it down the third-man, misses
wohoaa! Six! Pitched up, wasn't too quick a bowler and Uthappa went with the shot, over the bowler, maximum!
outside the off stump, on good length, dabbed it away to point
on the off-stump, tries to play it to the leg-side and it goes to the close-in fielder.
pitched up yet again, this time punched back and after a brief period of hesitation, they go for a single
shot, beauty, four! This was pitched up and Uthappa, who had been attempting this shot for some time now, finally gets it in the middle of the bat and through extra-cover
punched it back to the bowler, good length ball and Uthappa gets it in the middle
flicked it, and the ball holds before coming on to the bat, spoons up to mid-on and Munaf Patel needed to dive in front of him, he catches it but the ball seems to have come on the bounce.
pitched up, bit of swing away, wanted to punch it away, missed yet again.
down the leg-side, he tries to flick it away but misses and it is called a wide
